title: A11y evidence: dynamic theming contrast and keyboard nav for virtualized tooltips
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Scope: produce a consolidated accessibility evidence packet covering dynamic-theme contrast tokens, keyboard navigation flows for virtualized tables and charts, and tooltip/live-region behavior for VPAT submission. Goals: 1) Audit token contrast across light/dark/high-contrast theme permutations and produce per-token contrast ratios and remediation recommendations; 2) Define keyboard flows and focus management for virtualized table rows, interactive legend items, and chart tooltips (including tooltip opening/closing via keyboard and graceful focus return); 3) Implement small, low-risk component fixes (tokens, aria attributes, focus-visible styles) and author acceptance tests and automated checks (axe + Lighthouse + unit tests) so we can attach reproducible evidence to the VPAT. Out of scope: full redesign of charts or virtualization engine rewrite — we will adapt patterns at the component API layer and provide guidance for eng teams to adopt.
acceptance_criteria: Contrast audit spreadsheet with per-token ratios for light/dark/high-contrast themes and concrete token mapping recommendations (pass WCAG AA 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text where applicable)
Annotated keyboard-flow diagrams for virtualized tables, interactive legend lists, and chart tooltip lifecycle (open, focus inside, close, focus return)
PRs merging component-level fixes: focus-visible outline tokens, aria-expanded/aria-controls for legend buttons, and aria-describedby connectors for tooltips
Automated regression tests added to design-system repo: Storybook interaction tests + Jest/RTL assertions for focus management, and an axe snapshot test for each theme
A VPAT evidence bundle (Confluence page + artifacts) with test logs (axe/Lighthouse), device/screen-reader matrix (NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack), and signed checklist for compliance review
